scope: Partial batch 4: host HTTP execution receipts and research observation binding
implemented: Registered redteam_execution runs one recorded HTTP request under current session direction and persistent budgets
Session-scoped host-generated receipt IDs persist actual response, error, elapsed time and bounded captured bytes
Redirects are not followed, HTTPS certificate validation is preserved, endpoint/Host and request framing are checked before dispatch
Attempt count and Node stream-write completion count are separate; neither alone proves the server received a request
Research observations can derive packets and execution times from two distinct current host receipts, ignoring submitted packet substitutions
Receipts already used in observations cannot be recycled; response headers alone cannot turn identical status/body into support
Routine model rendering omits packets; detail is session-scoped
limitations: Receipts prove a host execution exchange, not target ownership, real identity, authorization impact or RCE; impactVerified is always false
No script execution, independent vhost, duplicate-header or streaming/chunked-request verification is implemented by this executor
Legacy submitted-packet observations remain explicitly untrusted
Finding delivery readiness is not yet bound to these receipts or an independent effect verifier
The database is not tamper-proof against local filesystem access; no claim of cryptographic isolation from an unrestricted agent is made
Latest source is not installed; actual Desktop flow and model token/recall comparison remain unverified
